Change c0546. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XXIV.

Context before (unchanged): You hate me; but your abhorrence cannot equal that with which I regard myself.

1818 text: I look on the hands which executed the deed; I think on the heart in which the imagination of it was conceived, and long for the moment when they will meet my eyes, when it will haunt my thoughts, no more.

1831 text: I look on the hands which executed the deed; I think on the heart in which the imagination of it was conceived, and long for the moment when these hands will meet my eyes, when that imagination will haunt my thoughts no more.

Diff: I look on the hands which executed the deed; I think on the heart in which the imagination of it was conceived, and long for the moment when [-they-] {+these hands+} will meet my eyes, when [-it-] {+that imagination+} will haunt my thoughts [-,-] no more.

Context after (unchanged): "Fear not that I shall be the instrument of future mischief.

result.rationale: Pronouns 'they'/'it' become explicit 'these hands' and 'that imagination', sharpening the focus on the creature's hands and conceived deed; the rephrasing keeps the same sense but adds emphasis on the agent's violence and the imagination behind it.
